description: Local SEO check of a business's website: whether the page states the business name, address and phone the person gives (NAP consistency), and whether it has LocalBusiness schema, click-to-call links and an embedded Google map. Use it for local SEO questions about a shop, clinic, restaurant or office's website. result has name, address and phone, each with status match, mismatch, not_found or profile_missing (no value given) and what the site states, localSchema (types and missing fields; null when there is none), telLinks and embeddedMap. It does not read the Google Business Profile itself. These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), result (the details below), resultId and reportUrl (null). The check saves nothing. When the person asks for a link to open or share later, pass resultId to share_report within an hour. Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

address.description: The street address on one line, such as "12 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701". Defaults to none, which leaves the address unchecked.

name.description: The business name, as on its signage.

phone.description: The phone number in any format, such as "+1 217 555 0100". Defaults to none, which leaves the phone unchecked.

url.description: The business's page, usually its home or contact page: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_local_seo_details
title: Check local SEO details
